# Michael Router

> A private, password-protected OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and free OpenRouter models.

Base URL: https://michael-router.vercel.app/v1
Authentication: Bearer token from MROUTER_PASSWORD. Never hard-code a password or provider key.

## Documentation

- [Agent guide](https://michael-router.vercel.app/AGENTS.md): Setup, model routing, streaming, and error recovery.
- [API reference](https://michael-router.vercel.app/docs/api.html): Authentication, endpoints, routing, streaming, errors, and limits.
- [CLI reference](https://michael-router.vercel.app/docs/cli.html): Install, login, configuration, every command, and exit codes.
- [Providers and models](https://michael-router.vercel.app/docs/providers.html): Model catalog and curl, Python, JavaScript, and CLI examples for all four providers.
